cmd:
cd '/srv/deep project'
if [ -f build.sh ]; then if head -c 512 build.sh | grep -q $'\r'; then printf "REMOTE_DT_SCRIPT_CRLF:%s\n" build.sh; exit 21; fi; bash -n build.sh || exit $?; fi

set -o pipefail
cd '/srv/deep project'
